note: Caption source for the promo film 'The Case File of Umer' (45 s, 24 fps). Times follow docs/promo/cues.json (the on-screen text cues) and docs/promo/STORYBOARD.md. There is no narration: the captions give the on-screen text plus short [sound] descriptions for viewers who cannot hear the score. Every fact comes from /content. The Urdu text was written for this project and NEEDS A NATIVE SPEAKER'S REVIEW before submission. `node scripts/promo/build-vtt.mjs` writes public/captions/promo.en.vtt and promo.ur.vtt from this file (cues are sequential: no overlaps).
